_comment: Drop-in sprite slots. Each key maps to a PNG path; if the file exists it REPLACES the hand-drawn vector art for that thing with no code change (see lib/game/art/art_registry.dart). Leave a path in place and just add the file. Recommended: transparent PNGs. Suggested sizes — characters ~256x512, item icons ~128x128, tree ~256x256, backgrounds ~1024x576 (tiled/stretched). Paths must live under a folder declared in pubspec.yaml flutter.assets.
